session_dialogue.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?
I'm feeling a bit anxious today. I got a notice about my insurance claim, and it's all a bit overwhelming.
That sounds really stressful. I can see how that notice might feel overwhelming. Let's try to break it down together.
I keep thinking I should have handled it better. I feel like I’m failing at being independent, like I’m not good enough.
It’s okay to feel that way. Change takes time, and it’s normal to feel frustrated when things don’t go as planned. Let’s work on small steps together.
I don’t know how to fix this. I keep second-guessing everything I’ve done, like I’m not actually in control.
It’s hard to feel in control when things feel so uncertain. But remember, even small actions can help. Let’s focus on one thing at a time.
I keep telling myself I should have checked everything before now. But the guilt just keeps coming, like I’m not doing enough to be okay.
Guilt can feel heavy, but it’s not a sign of failure. Let’s try to find a way to be kind to yourself, even in the middle of this.
I want to be kind to myself, but the thoughts just keep pulling me back. I feel like I’m not doing enough to be okay.
It’s hard to break free from those thoughts, but you’re already showing strength by wanting to be kind to yourself. Let’s try to build something small that feels like progress.
I don’t know where to start. Every time I try, I feel like I’m just making things worse, and I’m scared I’ll never get it right.
You don’t have to get it right all at once. Even small steps can help, and it’s okay to feel scared. Let’s try something simple together.
I’m trying, but the fear of messing up keeps me stuck. I just want to feel like I can handle this without falling apart.
It’s okay to feel afraid. You’re not alone in this, and it’s a sign of strength that you’re still trying. Let’s take it one small step at a time, together.
I don’t know if I can do this. Every time I try, I feel like I’m failing, and I’m so scared I’ll never be enough.
You’re not failing—you’re trying, and that’s what matters. It’s okay to feel scared, but you’re already stronger than you think. Let’s take one small step forward, even if it feels tiny.
I’m trying so hard, but the fear is still there. I just want to feel like I can do this without breaking.
You’re doing more than you realize, even if it doesn’t feel like it right now. Let’s focus on what you can do today, no matter how small it seems.
I don’t know what to do today. Everything feels too hard, and I’m afraid I’ll just fall apart again.
